source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    fill = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line = counts.most_common(2)[1][0]

    def dominant(values):
        c = Counter(values)
        color, n = c.most_common(1)[0]
        return color, n / len(values)

    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid)
            if dominant(row)[0] == line and dominant(row)[1] >= 0.70]
    cols = [j for j in range(w)
            if dominant([grid[i][j] for i in range(h)])[0] == line
            and dominant([grid[i][j] for i in range(h)])[1] >= 0.70]
    if len(rows) > 3 and rows and all(x == line for x in grid[rows[0]]):
        rows = rows[1:]
    if len(rows) > 3 and rows and all(x == line for x in grid[rows[-1]]):
        rows = rows[:-1]

    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(rows, rows[1:]):
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(cols, cols[1:]):
            corners = (grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1], grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1])
            color = corners[0]
            row.append(color if color != line and all(x == color for x in corners) else fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
